findings.text: follow-on: wilson_half_width implements the Wald/normal half-width z*sqrt(p(1-p)/n), not a Wilson interval; the fragment's own prose (srtj-cohort-estimate.html, 'the Wald half-width needs') names it correctly, so the symbol alone mislabels the estimator for any reader who trusts the name.

follow-on: the brief requires each arm's interval 'from the spread of per-call costs', but neither interval is built from that spread; the incumbent interval (lines 239-240, 248) spans escalation incidence between never and always firing, and the cascade interval (lines 259-263) uses the binomial spread of the chat share at the calibration n, while the recorded per-call sd_usd (lines 116, 127) is never used.

follow-on: the committed JSON's figure_path is the reviewer will find a dead pointer: it is the worker's worktree-absolute path /home/ITER/mcintos/Code/.reckon-worktrees/.../srtj-cohort-estimate/docs/figures/sn-review-through-jev/srtj-cohort-estimate/srtj-cohort-estimate.svg, which dies when the worktree is reclaimed, rather than the repository-relative path the figure is actually committed at.

follow-on: per_accepted divides each arm's per-item cost by ROUTE_SHARES[axis]['accept'], the cascade's calibrated accept share, for BOTH arms (lines 277-286, 402-405), so the incumbent arm's spend per accepted name is priced against the cascade's acceptance rate rather than the quorum's own, which is not measured.

follow-on: build_figure never applies the mandated plt.style.use('data-ink') (the committed SVG carries matplotlib's default tab10 fills #1f77b4/#ff7f0e, not the muted component palette), and gate-cohort-estimate.log records no render-to-PNG check of the figure as the sprint's Figures rule requires.

follow-on: commit b074eddf7 first created the figure at docs/figures/sn-review-through-jev/srtj-cohort-estimate.svg, outside the granted directory docs/figures/sn-review-through-jev/srtj-cohort-estimate; the net diff base..head is clean (the final commit relocates it inside the grant) and the excursion is disclosed in manifest.md:45-54, but the per-commit history still carries the out-of-scope create.

justifications.durability: no test asserts the estimate's numbers, so nothing reddens if srtj-cohort-estimate.json is hand-edited away from srtj-cohort-estimate-run.py's output.
justifications.evidence: gate-cohort-estimate.log records a real EXIT=0 and USD 0, reproduced byte-identically in a scratch rerun, but the interval basis deviates from the brief's per-call-cost-spread instruction (srtj-cohort-estimate-run.py:236-263).
justifications.fit: srtj-cohort-estimate-run.py:204 is named wilson_half_width while implementing the Wald half-width, and :321-359 renders with default matplotlib styling rather than the mandated data-ink style.
justifications.goal_fidelity: srtj-cohort-estimate.json records the cohort (464 items, seed 20261019, rule, precision argument) and both arms' totals with intervals and a wall plan, matching the goal's three deliverables.
justifications.reuse: no owner for a binomial sizing or interval helper exists in imas_codex, so srtj-cohort-estimate-run.py:204-209 adds one where the search found none.
justifications.scope_discipline: the net diff from 50459cc3f to 31a2c04a5 changes only the four granted paths, with one disclosed intermediate out-of-scope figure create at b074eddf7.
